digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter transport layer
propositions: The DC transport must implement TicketTransport, SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, and SupportsAbsenceProbe contracts using pycontribs/jira as an opt-in [jira-datacenter] extra with lazy imports to preserve dependency-free rebar.
Authentication uses Personal Access Tokens from JIRA_PAT env var with bearer token auth; URL and project come from typed config with fail-loud on ConfigError rather than env fallback.

TLS verification is never disabled; non-https URLs are rejected unless allow_insecure=true is set; certificate failures name the ca_bundle setting; allow_insecure affects URL scheme check only, not cert verification.
Every transport method returns raw payload shapes consumed by existing mappers, not jira.Issue objects; HTTP errors are not retried but timeouts are retried with 2s/5s backoff.

The DC transport is self-registered via import in adapters/__init__.py so select_backend('jira-datacenter') resolves after importing adapters; absence of this import causes BackendRegistryError at runtime.

Live tests via J5 harness prove all thirteen TicketTransport/SupportsLinks/SupportsComments/SupportsAbsenceProbe methods work end-to-end; NameIdentity user-search resolver returns authoritative identities for real users and raises BackendAssigneeNotFoundError for unknown ones; transitions to unavailable workflow names raise rather than silently no-op.
